C. METHODOLOGY NOTES (to be published with the report)
A 'No' on action is not an absence of impact

Q4 asks only about substantial action — a collaboration, pilot, funding, partnership or decision. Q5 captures effects that never became a project. Always read the two together, and never report the Q4 No rate on its own.
The survey does not measure a before/after change. It records what respondents say shifted. State this rather than implying a measured delta.
No single question is asked of every respondent about staying connected, so report named connections rather than a percentage.
Attribution sits inside a multi-part open answer, so some respondents will not supply it. Report it as a split of the responses that carry it, and state the base.
Q6 records when respondents say action began, not a verified date. Treat the timeline as indicative of pattern, not precise.
~800 to 1,000 invited; 150 to 250 completions expected. Respondents who collaborated are likelier to reply, so collaboration rates skew high.
Future-readiness findings represent 150 to 250 senior education leaders. They are not a sector-wide or population-level view.
